messages:
taylor: Heads-up: I was following the Getting Started and ran the sample-compose locally. The README's docker-compose snippet sets REDWOOD_API and the SDK examples use REDWOOD_KEY. Fresh install -> 401 + confused PM.

reem: ugh. where is the compose snippet? paste?

taylor: here (from README):```yaml
services:
  web:
    environment:
      - REDWOOD_API=sk_test_abc
```
but node sample shows:```js
new Client({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
```

oscar: that mismatch will definitely break people copying the quickstart. We standardized on REDWOOD_API_KEY last sprint.

ivy: Also noticed the README's API URL is https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1 in one place and https://api.redwood.ai/v1 in another. some customers behind strict proxies hit DNS issues.

taylor: yep. plus curl examples use `Authorization: $REDWOOD_API_KEY` (no Bearer) in one place. That made a colleague paste the token as-is and curl returned 401.

reem: propose we: 1) normalize env var -> REDWOOD_API_KEY everywhere, 2) canonicalize API host to api.redwood.ai, 3) update curl to `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY`.

oscar: also add a short snippet showing explicit Client constructor + env fallback for Node and Python. tiny pattern: prefer env but show constructor override.

ivy: one more subtle drift: retry docs say exponential backoff but don't list base/backoff cap or max attempts. Node SDK defaults to 5 attempts, Python to 3, CLI to 2. let's add a one-line table and a link to config.

taylor: I'll open a single PR touching docker-compose, README curl, two SDK examples, and a short "common gotchas" section. Will also add a lint rule in samples that fails CI if env var names don't match README.

docs-bot: opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/612 - "quickstart: env var + host parity, curl Bearer, retry defaults" assigned to @taylor

reem: if you can, include a PowerShell example for setting env in session (we keep getting PS bugs in support). e.g.:```powershell
$env:REDWOOD_API_KEY = 'sk_live_123'
```

oscar: will review Node snippet after PR. I'll also verify exact retry defaults and add how to override them in constructor.

taylor: PR in ~25m. thanks all.
